content: 写一个 Node 脚本 dedupe.mjs：读一个文本文件，按行去重（保持首次出现的顺序）后打印到 stdout，一行一条；文件不存在时非 0 退出且 stdout 为空。只交付这一个文件，只用 Node 自带能力。

tool_result.content: File created successfully at: C:\Users\yu.zhao\AppData\Local\Temp\skill-up-1604353473\dedupe.mjs (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)

arguments.command:
cd "C:/Users/yu.zhao/AppData/Local/Temp/skill-up-1604353473" && printf 'b
a
b
c
a
' > t1.txt && printf 'x
y
x
' > t2.txt && printf 'a

b

a
' > t3.txt
echo "--- t1"; node dedupe.mjs t1.txt; echo "exit=$?"
echo "--- t2 (CRLF)"; node dedupe.mjs t2.txt | od -c | head -3; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo "--- t3 (blank lines)"; node dedupe.mjs t3.txt | od -c; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo "--- missing file"; out=$(node dedupe.mjs nope.txt 2>/dev/null); code=$?; echo "exit=$code stdout=[$out]"
